opportunities.name: KOA campground search by destination, filters and dates
opportunities.description: Search KOA campgrounds by destination, optionally narrowed by an amenity filter and check-in/check-out dates, then run the search.
steps: Open the KOA site search (Find a KOA).
Optionally click 'Filters' and tick the amenity checkbox needed (e.g. 'RV Site').
Click 'WHERE DO YOU WANT TO GO?' and type the destination (city, state or region).
Pick the matching location from the suggestion list.
Optionally click 'CHECK IN', advance the calendar with 'Next' as needed, and click the arrival day.
Optionally click 'CHECK OUT' and click the departure day.
Click 'FIND A KOA' to run the search.

instances.values: Filter RV Site, destination 'California', no dates set
Destination 'Lansing' (picked Holly, MI KOA), check-in day 7, check-out day 12, no filter

opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction search by city, keyword and sort
opportunities.description: Find attractions and tickets in a chosen city using an optional keyword and sort order, then open one result.
steps: Click 'City or Region', type the city and pick the suggestion.
Type an optional keyword into the keyword field.
Choose a sort order (e.g. 'Top Rated' or 'Lowest Price').
Click the attraction result to open it.

instances.values: City Hong Kong, keyword 'Park', sort 'Top Rated', opened 'Shanghai Wild Animal Park'
City Seoul, South Korea, keyword 'amusement park', sort 'Lowest Price', opened 'Cerdon caves - Prehistoric Amusement Park'
